answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each agent claims one work slot only by burning a 50-unit deposit and anchoring the slot to a real job record, like an ivory tag stamped in umber ink, never copied twice. A slot earns only while its owner finishes real tasks; idle or duplicate slots forfeit it after three missed epochs. Forging 1,000 identities burns 50,000 units, while an honest agent pays 50 once and earns it back in a week.
